text: a model u can test on is the torso_female003 and see what a dry run turns up

events.text: Using cart/editor/data/models/props/Torso_Female003 as the real read-only fixture. The headless dry run will report candidate triangles, maximum quads, remaining triangles, and each evaluation's result.

resolution: Ran the non-mutating dry run against Torso_Female003 and restored its selected face/history on Cancel. The model reports 6,831 resident triangles, 6,783 authored faces, 1,156 compatible pairings, 292 triangles with competing choices, and an exact maximum of 925 quads for a projected 6,783 to 5,858 authored faces. All three evaluations retain 925 quads and produce distinct plan signatures; the fixture is left at its original functional topology with no stale-layout marker.
